title: Rate Limited Details
description: Recommended details shape for RATE_LIMITED errors. Provides rate limit window information so agents can plan request pacing.

limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the window

remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window

window_seconds.description: Duration of the rate-limit window in seconds

scope.x-deprecated-enum-values-doc: Deprecated in 3.3 and removed in 4.0 (#8791): `global` is a Python keyword, so generated SDKs must rename it. Use `all`. Receivers accept both values through 3.x. Send the replacement only when the release served is 3.3 or later; a 3.2 receiver treats it as an unknown value. A published file, such as `adagents.json`, keeps the original through 3.x.

enumDescriptions.account: The limit applies to the calling account.
enumDescriptions.tool: The limit applies to the tool that was called.
enumDescriptions.global: **Deprecated in 3.3**, removed in 4.0: use `all`. The limit applies across the whole agent.
enumDescriptions.all: The limit applies to all traffic the agent receives, from every caller, account and tool. Replaces the deprecated `global`; a receiver on AdCP 3.2 or earlier treats it as an unknown value. Not the same as `agent` in `enums/error-scope.json`, which means the calling buyer agent.
